items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Ram Ramirez comes in the band shortly and replaces Tommy Fulford Welpert for a while. That's when Tommy was sick.

ctx.x: Sometime the band would be up to extra -- you know, the spirit will be real high. We'd go back and get some of the things that we couldn't do anything with. Sometime we get something out of it that particular night. if give it a number (Inaudible) we did, we (Inaudible), Put it in the book and we'd play it.
A couple of new people who were in the band -- some of them temporarily. Like Ram Ramirez comes in the band shortly and replaces Tommy Fulford Welpert for a while.
